phase_prompt.label: Phase 2
phase_prompt.summary: The wind intensifies, carrying holographic screens and cascading green code that swirl around the environment; crystalline particles refract light into a dynamic data stream; the glyph lattice becomes more pronounced, pulsing in sync with the wind’s acceleration.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic depiction of a mountain peak with a strong wind: holographic screens float in the air, cascading green code streams across them, crystalline particles refract light into a dynamic data stream, ancient glyphs pulse in sync with the wind, creating a cinematic, industrial mysticism atmosphere.
